description: Voies navigables principales is a dataset listed in data.gov.be, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Departement Omgeving. Navigable up to 600 tons was digitized by Man and Space (1993). The rest was supplemented by the database management. Purpose: Flanders structural plan. Coverage: Departement Omgeving. The portal shows the English title as "Main waterways" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Departement Omgeving. Its keywords include AROHM, HOOFDWATERWEGEN, MENS EN RUIMTE, STRUCTUURPLAN VLAANDEREN, WATERWEG, BEVAARBAARHEID. The listing shows 1998-05-07 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-be.
